import copy,json
from work import evaluate
p={'edges':{'a>b':{},'b>c':{'role':'op'}},'retry_limit':2}
cases=[({'from':'a','to':'b'},{'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'}),({'from':'x','to':'y'},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'bad','attempts':False},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'op','attempts':False},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':-1},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':0},{'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'}),({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':1},{'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'}),({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':2},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':1.0},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'})]
for req,exp in cases:
 rb,pb=copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(p); got=evaluate(req,p); assert got==exp,(req,got,exp); assert req==rb and p==pb
